events.name: Bash
events.head: Show HEAD, file state and the checkout client code
events.input: $ git rev-parse --short HEAD && git status --short app/src/lib/checkout-client.ts app/src/lib/form-log.ts app/scripts/probe-checkout-utm.mjs app/src/app/api/checkout/route.ts && wc -l app/src/lib/checkout-client.ts app/scripts/probe-checkout-utm.mjs app/src/app/api/checkout/route.ts && sed -n 1,165p app/src/lib/checkout-client.ts

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find UTM resolver usages, stale location.search reads, and the checkout route
events.input: $ grep -n "resolveUtm\|tantra_first_touch_utm\|FIRST_TOUCH" -r app/src | head -40; echo ---; grep -rn "location.search" app/src --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx | grep -i "utm\|checkout" | head -20; echo ---; sed -n 1,200p app/src/app/api/checkout/route.ts

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the UTM probe and the existing Dodo read helper
events.input: $ cat app/scripts/probe-checkout-utm.mjs; ls app/scripts/.tmp135/dodo.mjs && sed -n 1,60p app/scripts/.tmp135/dodo.mjs | sed -E 's/(sk_|dodo_)[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{8,}/[redacted]/g'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the UTM resolver, list checkout callers, check local servers and Dodo env names
events.input: $ sed -n 40,105p app/src/lib/form-log.ts; echo ---; grep -rn "dodopayments\|startBuildPassCheckout\|staticCheckoutUrl\|startProCheckout" app/src cloud --include="*.ts" --include="*.tsx" --include="*.js" -l | grep -v node_modules | head -30; echo ---; grep -rnE "location\.search" app/src | grep -iE "utm" | head; echo ---; for p in 4322 3000 3001 4321; do curl -s -o /dev/null -m 3 -w "$p %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:$p/vip/; done; grep -n "DODO" app/.env.local | sed -E 's/=.*/=<set>/'; sed -n 1,60p app/src/lib/dodo.ts | grep -n "live\|test\|BASE\|env\."

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read-only list of Dodo payments since the fix, with masked ids and metadata

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check other checkout link builders, where first touch is saved, and how the dev server starts
events.input: $ grep -nE "dodopayments|startBuildPassCheckout|staticCheckoutUrl|startProCheckout" app/src/app/vip/vip-client.tsx app/src/app/masterclass/masterclass-client.tsx app/src/components/masterclass/funnel-os.tsx app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts app/src/lib/card-education.ts app/src/lib/guides/tools.ts "app/src/app/(site)/pro/pro-client.tsx" | cut -c1-220; echo ---; grep -rn "rememberUtm" app/src | cut -c1-160; echo ---; grep -n "4322\|\"name\"\|runtimeArgs\|\"port\"" .claude/launch.json | head -30; grep -n "\"dev\"\|\"start\"\|\"build\"" app/package.json

events.name: Bash
events.head: Start the local dev server on port 4322 and wait for /vip
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app && (nohup npx next dev -p 4322 > /tmp/t124-dev.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 40); do c=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -m 5 -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:4322/vip/); [ "$c" = "200" ] && break; sleep 2; done; echo vip $c; curl -s -o /dev/null -m 60 -w "workshop %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:4322/workshop/; tail -3 /tmp/t124-dev.log | cut -c1-200

events.name: Bash
events.head: Tighten the probe to all four UTMs and add a real landing check

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run the checkout UTM probe against the local server
events.input: $ curl -s -o /dev/null -m 60 -L -w "vip %{http_code} %{url_effective}\n" http://localhost:4322/vip/; node scripts/probe-checkout-utm.mjs 2>&1 | tail -8; echo exit $?
